items.title: 3 Retail Dividend Stocks to Watch This Black Friday
items.summary: Black Friday crowds vanish by Monday, but one retailer's dividend check lands before the holiday sales are even tallied. Three big-box giants promise income all year, yet each hides a catch that could test that promise.

items.title: Apple, Exxon and Lowe’s Are Rewarding Shareholders Beyond Their Regular Dividends
items.summary: One of these three dividend payers yields just 0.30%, another has stopped buying back shares entirely, and the third just promised never to cut its payout. Each handles the cash differently, and the differences matter if you live on portfolio income.

items.title: 11 Big Funds Bought Home Depot Last Quarter, While 13 Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 11 bought Home Depot and 13 sold, led by GMO’s new $214 million stake and Lone Pine Capital’s exit. Two of the buyers also added Lowe’s, which trades at about 19x forward earnings against about 23x for Home Depot.

items.title: Highnote files for national bank charter
items.summary: The embedded finance and payments firm counts BNY and home-improvement chain Lowe’s as clients.

items.title: Investors Heavily Search Lowe's Companies, Inc. (LOW): Here is What You Need to Know
items.summary: Zacks.com users have recently been watching Lowe's (LOW) quite a bit. Thus, it is worth knowing the facts that could determine the stock's prospects.

items.title: 13% Upside for Home Depot? Guggenheim Thinks So, and Here’s How
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGuggenheim cut its Home Depot price target to $400 from $425 and kept its Buy rating. That still points to about 13% upside.

items.summary: The savings are huge, but many of the people who shop there won’t like it when they find out how.

items.title: Best Dividend Stocks to Buy for Dependable Dividend Growth
items.summary: How do you find the best dividend stocks to buy? Income investors know there's no substitute for regular dividend increases over the long haul.
